stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class): 11,436 applied, 6,940 admitted (61%), 1,602 enrolled (counts from the NCES admissions file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal; College Navigator shows the same 11,436 applicants and 61% admitted / 23% yield). No CDS used: the newest Common Data Set on ir.mines.edu is 2022-2023, so the in-state / out-of-state / international applicant split, GPA distribution, waitlist, early-round counts and admission factors (CDS-only items) are not added. SAT/ACT percentiles cover the 42% (670) / 18% (288) of enrolled first-years who submitted scores. Mines is test-optional. Undergraduate enrollment 6,195 and 187 nonresident-alien undergraduates are IPEDS fall 2024; the student-to-faculty ratio of 18 to 1 is from College Navigator. Calendar is semester (finaid.mines.edu/scholarships: awards renewable for 8 consecutive fall/spring semesters).

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.
